title: Model Binding & Validation
description: Understand how ASP.NET Core maps HTTP request data to action parameters and how to enforce data integrity through server-side and client-side validation.
longDescription: This module covers model binding from basic simple-type binding through complex nested objects and collections, then transitions into validation — from manual ModelState checks to data annotation attributes, custom validators, and unobtrusive client-side validation. You will build practical examples including file uploads, contact forms, and fully validated registration pages.
whatYouLearn: Understand how model binding maps HTTP data to action method parameters
Bind simple types, complex types, nested objects, and collections
Implement file uploads using IFormFile and model binding
Use [Bind(Prefix)] and [BindNever] for advanced binding control
Enforce validation with ModelState.AddModelError() and ModelState.IsValid
Apply built-in data annotation attributes (Required, StringLength, Range, EmailAddress, etc.)
Create custom validation attributes by inheriting from ValidationAttribute
Use IValidatableObject for cross-field validation rules
Enable unobtrusive client-side validation with jQuery Validation
Implement remote validation for asynchronous server-side checks
